question:
Let $n\ge2$ and let $a_1\le a_2\le\cdots\le a_n$ be positive integers such that
\[
\sum_{i=1}^n a_i=\prod_{i=1}^n a_i.
\]
Prove that
\[
\sum_{i=1}^n a_i\le2n
\]
and determine when equality holds.
